data.text: Raise the MCP tool core tier budget so the ratchet stops failing (operator authorized this raise). Raise CORE_BUDGET to 50000 (25% headroom), add a one-line comment noting the operator raise (date 2026-11-08, reason = accumulated new tools), ensure the two assertions referencing CORE_BUDGET still pass, run affected tests/test_mcp_tool_budget.py scoped unit_tests BEFORE merge, cross-family review (grok/x.ai + gemini/google), merge, complete --model deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813-Godzila.

data.claim: Raising CORE_BUDGET from 40000 to 50000 in tests/test_mcp_tool_budget.py and tests/test_mcp_tool_tiers.py makes the failing ratchet tests pass
data.falsifier: core tools/list would have to exceed 50000 bytes for the ratchet tests to still fail after the raise
data.mechanism: core tools/list is 40261 bytes, so 40261 > 40000 (old ratchet) fails but 40261 <= 50000 (new ratchet) passes
